name: youtube-mcp
description: YouTube audience-research MCP: public video/channel/comment stats and growth velocity from the YouTube Data API v3, plus owner-only viewer demographics (age group, gender, country, device, OS) from the YouTube Analytics API over OAuth. NETWORKED asset — holds YOUTUBE_API_KEY and an OAuth refresh token; see AGENTS.md 'Networked assets'. Ledgers the 100-search-calls-per-day quota bucket and caches to disk. Labels every demographic split as logged-in viewers only, and every transcript as an unofficial source. Runs as an asset under orchestrator-mcp.
